_comment: Scoped waivers for scripts/check_formula_agreement.py. Each entry is {pali, rationale, renderings}, where renderings maps each record key to the exact English that record is approved to use for the phrase. An entry without a rationale or without renderings is rejected; a record the entry does not name, or a named record whose English later differs from what was approved, is reported again. Two entries for one phrase are rejected. Prefer reconciling the records; add an exception only when the difference is intentional and the context rule that produces it is cited in the rationale.
